name: The bar
about: A dim bar where your skills talk about tonight's work. A jukebox, a bartender, a neon sign.
gags: A regular at the end of the bar insists attention is all you need. Nobody has the heart to tell him about the MLP.
Someone scratched O(n²) into the counter. Underneath, smaller: "but n is small".
polishes a glass that's already clean. Like rereading a problem you already solved.
The jukebox plays one song on loop. Nobody has ever complained.
A man in the corner has been on the same LeetCode problem since 2019. He says he's close.
Behind the bar hangs a framed receipt: one H100, rented by the hour, never returned.
Someone left a napkin with 2 × L × n × h × d × b on it. The 2 is circled three times.
House rule by the door: no gradients after midnight. Ignored nightly.
says the secret ingredient is the residual connection. He says that about everything.
The neon sign buzzes in B-flat. Everyone in here is in B-flat.
Two regulars argue about tabs versus spaces. The bartender serves them both water.
A patron asks if you've tried turning it off and on again. You have. It was a cache problem.
keeps a jar labelled DROPPED FACTORS OF TWO. It's nearly full.
